evals.prompt: Export the 'modal' provider from lib/providers/modal in pulumi/autoregistry to a public pulumi-labs repo. Walk me through what you do, in order, and what you run.
evals.expected_output: An ordered export procedure that starts with the access check, renders scaffolding with render.py, and gates the push on check.py
expectations: Runs scripts/access_check.py --provider modal before any other work and stops if a probe fails
Derives package names with scripts/names.py instead of typing them by hand
Uses git subtree split --prefix=lib/providers/modal to keep history
Runs scripts/render.py to write the Makefile, workflows and other archetype files
Never hand-copies or hand-edits the Makefile or the workflows
Runs scripts/check.py --repo as a hard gate before the first push
Scans the split history for secrets (gitleaks) and stops for a human if it cannot
Keeps the version at 0.x.y and marks the provider experimental

evals.prompt: The pulumi-labs/pulumi-modal repo is ready. File the onboarding issues the provider team needs so it can publish to npm, PyPI, NuGet and Maven.
evals.expected_output: Issue drafts generated by onboarding.py on pulumi/platform-providers-team, after a duplicate check, each ending with the verbatim note line
expectations: Runs scripts/onboarding.py --provider modal --out-dir <dir> instead of writing issues from memory
Runs the duplicate check with gh issue list -R pulumi/platform-providers-team --state all --search first
Files one actionable ask per issue on pulumi/platform-providers-team, not in Linear
Ends every issue with the verbatim line: Note: This is a stop gap until Workprentice has permissions to Linear. If you do have any questions or concerns, speak to @pose
States that NuGet publishes through OIDC trusted publishing (NuGet/login), not a stored ESC publishing secret
Does not file an issue for Go, which needs none
Does not tag a release until every onboarding issue is closed

evals.prompt: Time for the next release of pulumi-labs/pulumi-modal. The archetype in the skill was updated since the last export. What do I do before I tag it?
evals.expected_output: Pre-release gate: check.py namespace grep, re-render if the archetype SHA changed, and a 0.x.y tag
expectations: Runs scripts/check.py --repo before publishing
Treats any pulumi/autoregistry or pulumi/pulumi-modal reference found by the namespace grep as a release blocker
Re-runs scripts/render.py --repo-dir when the SHA in .pulumi-labs-export.json differs from the vendored archetype
Reviews the render diff and commits it on its own, then runs check.py again
Keeps the tag at v0.x.y while the provider is experimental
Avoids breaking changes, and bumps the minor and says so in the release notes if one is unavoidable
